hydration.title: Adequate Daily Water Intake
hydration.source: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
hydration.summary: Adequate daily fluid intake is about 15.5 cups (3.7 liters) for men and 11.5 cups (2.7 liters) for women. About 20% comes from food, with the remainder from beverages.
hydration.citation: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. 2004. Dietary Reference Intakes for Water, Potassium, Sodium, Chloride, and Sulfate. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
keyFindings: Water is the best choice for hydration

alcohol.title: Moderate Alcohol Consumption Guidelines
alcohol.source: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and U.S. Department of Agriculture
alcohol.summary: Dietary Guidelines for Americans recommend that adults who choose to drink do so in moderation: up to 1 drink per day for women and up to 2 drinks per day for men.
alcohol.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture and U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020-2025. 9th Edition. December 2020.
keyFindings: Excessive alcohol use increases health risks
Moderate consumption may have some cardiovascular benefits

smoking.title: Health Consequences of Smoking
smoking.summary: The health consequences of smoking—50 years of progress: a report of the Surgeon General. Smoking remains the leading cause of preventable disease and death in the United States.
smoking.citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. The Health Consequences of Smoking—50 Years of Progress: A Report of the Surgeon General. Atlanta: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion, Office on Smoking and Health, 2014.
keyFindings: No safe level of smoking exists
Smoking damages nearly every organ in the body
Quitting smoking has immediate and long-term health benefits

physical_activity.title: Physical Activity Guidelines
physical_activity.summary: Adults should do at least 150-300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity throughout the week, or at least 75-150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity.
physical_activity.citation: World Health Organization. WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2020.
keyFindings: Regular physical activity prevents chronic diseases
10,000 steps per day is a good general target
Even small amounts of activity are beneficial

heart_rate.title: Resting Heart Rate and Cardiovascular Health
heart_rate.summary: A normal resting heart rate for adults ranges from 60 to 100 beats per minute. A lower resting heart rate generally indicates better cardiovascular fitness.
heart_rate.citation: American Heart Association. All About Heart Rate (Pulse). 2021.
keyFindings: Lower resting heart rate indicates better fitness
Regular exercise can lower resting heart rate
Unusually high or low heart rates should be evaluated

weekly_tracking.title: Benefits of Health Tracking
weekly_tracking.summary: Self-monitoring of health behaviors through tracking apps is associated with improved health outcomes and increased adherence to health goals.
weekly_tracking.citation: Shin, G., Jarrahi, M. H., Fei, Y., Karami, A., Gafinowitz, N., Byun, A., & Lu, X. (2019). Wearable activity trackers, accuracy, adoption, acceptance and health impact: A systematic literature review. Journal of Biomedical Informatics, 93, 103153.
